description: What the two Alexia windows may ask this process to do: set the tray's tooltip, hide the overlay, restart after an update, check for one, start at sign-in, read the machine's temperature sensors for the Local stats page, take a picture of the Settings or Activity sheet for its genie, lay Apple's Liquid Glass over parts of the page and click the trackpad as it moves, and zoom the main window's text with ⌘+ and ⌘-.

remote.comment: The shell is served by core over loopback, so the page is a remote origin from Tauri's point of view. Only that origin, and only the permissions below. A remote origin may call the app's own commands only where they are granted here by name, so every command in main.rs's generate_handler! has its allow- line.
